description: RightShip's Maritime Emissions Portal (MEP) is a web dashboard for port operators that estimates ship-sourced emissions in and around a port. It combines third-party Automatic Identification System (AIS) vessel movement data with RightShip's own vessel data from its GHG Rating, including vessel specifications and energy-saving equipment, to calculate time- and location-specific emissions. RightShip says the dashboard measures and reports 16 vessel-sourced emission types across all vessels and operating modes, giving a port's emissions profile including scopes 1 and 3, and uses heatmaps and zoning to show where emissions occur. The methodology was independently validated by Ricardo to align with EMEP/EEA Tier 3 and is referenced in Ports Australia's guidance. Coverage: any port where AIS data are available; RightShip cites global deployments over several years. Format and access: a hosted subscription service for ports and terminals. Licence and cost: proprietary and paid; no price is published. Caveats: vendor description, with the underlying vessel data and model not public. It supports port air quality and emissions inventories, capacity planning and exposure studies. It relates to the EMSA THETIS-MRV shipping CO2 data and the World Port Index in the catalogue.
